name: Neko Para Vol.1 Soleil Kaiten Shimashita!
original_name: ネコぱら Vol.1 ソレイユ開店しました！
source:
What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! 

Minazuki Kashou, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie. 

But upon moving out, hidden amongst his things were two of the catgirls ("neko"), Chocola and Vanilla, that the family had been raising. When he tried to send them back, they begged and pleaded until he gave in and now they've opened La Soleil together. 

With two nekos who really, REALLY love their master trying their very best and occasionally failing -- a heartful comedy opens for business! 

See the Sayori NEKO WORKs’ mascots Chocola and Vanilla like never before, moving, and in full voice on screen. And now with the E-mote System, the characters smoothly move on screen changing expression and poses in countless ways. 

[Edited from the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=339048194]Steam Greenlight page[/url]]
translation:
《NEKOPARA》是什么？当然是猫咪天堂！

水无月嘉祥出身于世代制作和果子的日本家庭，他离家开设了自己的糕点店“菓子铺La Soleil”。

但搬家时，他的行李中藏着家里饲养的两只猫娘：巧克力和香草。他试图把她们送回家，两人却苦苦哀求，最终他只好答应她们一起开店。

两只非常非常爱主人的猫娘努力工作、偶尔失败——充满温情的喜剧开张了！

在屏幕上观看Sayori与NEKO WORKs的吉祥物巧克力和香草前所未有的动态与全语音表现。借助E-mote系统，角色可以在屏幕上流畅移动，以无数种方式改变表情和姿势。

[改自[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=339048194]Steam Greenlight页面[/url]]
